name: php85-domain-architecture/course
description: Advanced Domain Architecture & Tactical DDD — PHP 8.5. Dependencies are needed from Module 3 onwards; Modules 0-2 are plain PHP with no vendor directory.

scripts-descriptions.check: Environment, course integrity, and how far through the lessons you are
scripts-descriptions.verify: Syntax-check every file, probe every 8.4/8.5 feature, run every reference solution, and regress
scripts-descriptions.regression: Run every earlier lesson's spec against the newest version of every class
scripts-descriptions.test: Run the PHPUnit suites, one process per file
